clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Horde warriors face a trial before Thun'grim Firegaze will forge their mail. They gather rare materials and prove themselves against dangerous foes across the lands, then bring their bounty to the reclusive smith. He hammers it into armor built for battle.

In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze forges armor only for warriors who meet his demands. The reclusive orc sends them far and wide to gather tough beast parts, rare metal, and alchemical reagents before he lights his bellows. The finished hauberk offers protection and marks the endurance and grit its wearer has shown, earning recognition from veteran fighters throughout the Horde.

Thun'grim makes his demands punishing by design. Horde arms and armor are expected to carry the sweat and blood of their wearer from the moment they are made. When you hand over the finished Brutal Hauberk, the smith offers no praise. He expects you to prove the armor in brutal combat and return with stories of blood and honor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, friend. Here is the product of your toil.
May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.
